**Terms I found ambiguous:**
- **Joining multi-line triggers (ADR-0070):** the rule says to join lines with one space but doesn't say whether to strip each line's leading `- ` or indent first. I kept them verbatim, so the trigger text has `- ` markers and runs of three spaces. If the script trims lines, this trigger text will differ while the class (`version`) stays the same.
- **`v1` as a version (ADR-0053, ADR-0068):** the second version form counts any bare `v1` with a space on each side. That makes "v1 exclusion" (meaning the pack's first-release scope) a `version` trigger. This is what the Terms decide, but it differs from the plain reading, as noted for ADR-0053.
